correctness.rationale: For every alpha>0 the beta density and transformation u=s(1-r), v=sr have exact Jacobian s and positivity support. At s<1, density odds at r=1/2 versus 1/4 depend nontrivially on s for alpha≠1 and are constant at alpha=1. For s>1 the positive conditional support varies with s. At alpha=1 the piecewise law integrates to one, conditional variances and marginals follow from uniform intervals, and symbolic integration confirms the nonzero squared-balance/eigenvalue covariance. The exact symbolic and rational checker runs on the packaged file. Finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: Two-state stationary balance and relaxation eigenvalue are the two most natural nontrivial observables of a stochastic kernel. Their coupling is important to understanding priors on transition matrices; the nonnegative-eigenvalue independence is sharply unique among symmetric Dirichlet row priors and fails across negative eigenvalues. The entire uniform-prior joint law provides precise conditional variability, including a variance plateau and a strict higher-moment dependence invisible to the usual covariance. It is a complete natural classification, not an arbitrary single finite statistic.
